headline: Sales growth broadens while auto refinish weighs on margins
summary_short: Net sales rose 7% y/y to $4.495B on 4% organic growth (2pt volume, 2pt price), while reported diluted EPS of $1.95 fell 1.5% y/y and adjusted EPS of $2.23 was roughly flat as aerospace and Latin America strength offset softer automotive refinish demand.
summary_long: Organic sales grew 4% for a sixth straight quarter, broad-based across 8 of 9 businesses, led by aerospace and Latin America architectural coatings. Performance Coatings EBITDA fell 5% y/y as automotive refinish volumes declined against a tough comparison and a slower claims-recovery pace; Architectural Coatings EBITDA margin expanded 100bp on pricing and cost control, and Industrial Coatings EBITDA rose 2% on share gains despite input-cost inflation. The company covered ~90% of COGS inflation with pricing this quarter, targeting 100% by Q4. Net income of $437M (diluted EPS $1.95) was down slightly y/y; adjusted EPS of $2.23 was roughly flat. Net debt fell $415M y/y to $5.3B; cash and short-term investments totaled $1.6B. Management reaffirmed full-year adjusted EPS guidance of $7.70-$8.10.

drivers.explanation: Sixth consecutive quarter of organic growth (+4%), volumes and price each contributing 2 points; aerospace and Latin America architectural coatings led, offsetting weaker automotive refinish demand.
Growth driven by +2% volumes, +2% selling prices, +2% favorable FX translation and +1% from acquisitions versus the prior year.
Automotive refinish coatings volume declines and cost-of-goods-sold inflation pressured segment margins, partially offset by pricing actions and cost-control initiatives.
Net interest expense rose to $29M from $18M and operating income declined, partly offset by a 110bp lower effective tax rate of 22.3%.
